3020-S62S2 ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT (this "Agreement") dated as of December 13,2012, is made by and between VINCENT DOWNING, an individual, residing at 128 East 70" Street, New York, New York 10021 ("Transferor") and 215 W 28TH EQUITIES, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, Hempstead,New York 11552("Transferee"); WITNESSETH THAT: WHEREAS, Transferor is the owner of certain land ("Transferor's Parcel") in the City of New York, and the. buildings and improvements thereon ("Transferor's Building"), located at 221West 28"hStreet,New York, NewYork 10001 and known as Block 778,Lot 28 on the Tax Map (the "Tax Map") of the City of New York, New York County and more particularly described in Schedule "A" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land, together with Transferor's Building being herein referred to as "Transferor's Property,"); and WHEREAS, Transferee is the owner of certain land adjacent to Transferor's Property ("Transferee's Adjacent Land") in the City of New York, and the buildings and improvements thereon ("Transferee's Adjacent Existing Building"), known as Block: 778 Lots: 29, 30 and 31 on the Tax Map, and as more particularly described in Schedule "B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof; and WHEREAS, Transferee proposes (but is not obligated) to construct a new building or additions or renovations or alterations to the buildings and improvements currently on Transferee's Property (said new building and improvements and any improvements or additions orrenovationsoralterations thereto andreplacements thereofbeingherein collectively referred to as "Transferee's New Building"; Transferee's Adjacent Land together with Transferee's Existing Building and Transferee's New Building, collectively, “Transferee's Property"); and WHEREAS, Transferee's New Building will contain more floor area ("Floor Area"), as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution (the "Zoning Resolution") of the City of New York, effective as of December 15, 1961, as amended from time to time, than is now available for useinrespect of Transferee'sPropertyunder the"floor area ratio"limitation contained in the present Zoning Resolution, with the result that Transferee desires to utilize the procedure availableunder the Zoning Resolution for combining Transferee's Propertyand Transferee'sNewBuilding with such limitation(whichprocedure willmake available to Transferee for such purpose all or a portion of the unused Floor Area attributable to the Transferor's Property). (For purposes of this Agreement, references to "floor area", "floor area in Section12-10 of theZoning Resolution); and WHEREAS, Transferor is transferring to Transferee all of the unused floor area now or hereafter appurtenant to Transferor's Parcel, which the parties acknowledge as of the date REI05770\00101492994v4 24

hereof are 18,664 square feet of Floor Area, being hereinafter collectively referred to as the "Excess Rights"; and WHEREAS, Transferee and Transferor are simultaneously herewith executing and delivering a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resoiution (the "Declaration"), which makes such procedure available to Transferee for such purpose by creating a single zoning lot (the "Combined Zoning Lot") out of Transferee's Property and Transferor's Property; NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing, Developer and Transferor hereby agree asfollows: (1) Transfer. Transferor hereby sells, conveys, assigns and transfers to Transferee the Excess Rights in perpetuity and agrees that Transferee may (but is not obligated to) utilize the Excess Rights in the construction of Transferee's New Building or as otherwise determined by Transferee. Transferor agrees that Transferee may use the lot area of Transferor's Land in calculating any Bonus Floor Area (as hereinafter defined). (2） Easements; Development Limitations. 1. Transferor hereby grants to Transferee the following permanent and perpetual easements (the "Easements") on, over, above and/or with respect to Transferor's Parcel: easement ("Light and Air Easement") in, on, over and above Transferor's Parcel for light, air andviewoverandabovethatportionofTransferor'sPropertywhichliesbelowahorizontal plane drawn at an elevation of 107.16feet measured above the Manhattan Highway Datum (whichis2.75feetabove theNationalGeodeticSurveyDatumof1929,UnitedStatesCoastand Geodetic survey datum, mean sea level, Sandy Hook, New Jersey), said elevation of 107.16 feet being hereinafter called the "Transferor's Maximum Height", and the portion of the Transferor's Property below such elevation of 107.16 feet being hereinafter called the "Transferor Envelope". In furtherance and not in limitation of the foregoing, Transferor shall separate Light and Air Easement in the form as may be required by the Department of Buildings to permit openings in the adjacent wall of the Transferee's Building that provide legally required light and air to rooms within the Transferee's Building.
